title: 0.2.15 OTA stability and interrupted-update recovery
summary: This update fixes OTA jobs that could hang at the file-apply stage, prevents duplicate update processes, and restores the previous runtime automatically after an interrupted update.
highlights: Only one OTA update can run at a time, so repeated clicks no longer start multiple robocopy jobs.
File synchronization now stops the running platform processes and uses short robocopy retry limits instead of waiting indefinitely on locked files.
If an update is interrupted halfway, the next launch or update attempt automatically restores the previous runtime from the rollback snapshot.
The update log handle is released immediately after the updater starts, reducing Windows file-lock cleanup problems.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
